body:
## Parent

Part of #73: Correct F07 and downstream evidence freeze to one Matchweek-wide cutoff.

## What to build

New MatchVet Matchweeks get one F07 evidence boundary derived from the earliest exact INCLUDED kickoff across the complete F06 freeze. Each INCLUDED membership's immutable F07 reference keeps its exact membership, revision, and policy provenance while naming the same boundary. Existing per-match F07 artifacts replay under their original rule and bytes.

## Scope

- F07: `match_evidence_cutoff` policy dispatch, boundary derivation, persistence, and replay.
- F06 admission: `matchweek_membership`, `matchweek_membership_repository`; require complete original Friday–Monday eligibility across all seven scopes, including protection against a cold late-start freeze that omitted a started/completed earlier match.
- Keep F06 membership policy, source adapters, and creation metadata meanings unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add `MATCHWEEK_EARLIEST_INCLUDED_KICKOFF_MINUS_LEAD_TIME`; initial corrected configuration explicitly uses `lead_time_seconds=21600`. There is no implicit numeric default.
- [ ] Derive one T from the whole exact F06 freeze and exact controlling kickoff of every INCLUDED membership. All F07 results have the identical `cutoff_at_utc`, including when a caller asks to persist a single membership.
- [ ] Fail closed before corrected publication for incomplete seven-scope/original-slate evidence, unresolved potentially earlier eligibility, an empty INCLUDED set, a missing/date-only/malformed kickoff, or an undefined minimum/T.
- [ ] Keep old `KICKOFF_MINUS_LEAD_TIME` arithmetic, F07 schema/payload/digest/canonical bytes, and retained old cutoffs unchanged. Old F07 artifacts still replay by their original rule; a new reader refuses unsupported rules without reinterpreting them.
- [ ] Focused tests cover Friday/Monday equality, an earliest match in a different league, single-member persistence validating the whole freeze, cold late-start refusal, incomplete and imprecise kickoff refusal, boundary timestamps, changed-policy identities, and legacy canonical/replay compatibility.
- [ ] Run those focused tests, Ruff for changed Python, and `git diff --check`.

## Blocked by

None. Existing F06/F07 contracts #43/#57/#58 are complete.

All verification uses isolated temporary stores or deterministic synthetic inputs. Do not open or modify either live SQLite store, acquire fixtures or network data, publish live F artifacts, or send a Sigstore/RFC3161 request. Do not rewrite old artifacts, released issues, migration files, or historical `.audit` evidence. Do not implement F11–F16 downstream selection gates in this ticket.

comments.body: Implemented and pushed as 42f5abd. Focused F07 and F06 checks pass; no migration or live-store work was performed.

Reopening to correct the F07 admission guard. The Friday 00:00 calendar boundary may reject a complete freeze created before the actual common cutoff; investigating against the #74 acceptance criteria before considering #75.

Corrected and pushed as 66bb487. F07 now uses the exact common T for the pre-freeze deadline, accepts timely Friday freezes after calendar start, and refuses retained in-window NOT_SCHEDULED candidates or unresolved kickoff eligibility. Focused F01/F06/F07 checks, Ruff, and diff-check pass; no migration or live-store work was performed.

title: F07: derive and replay one cutoff from the complete F06 freeze
